r3p05_dec103_thinning_boundary_audit.arithmetic_precision: decimal.Decimal prec=80 strictly sound directed bounds (.next_minus() on ln() and exp(), ROUND_FLOOR on eff_prob & q_lo, ROUND_CEILING on 1-exp and division)

single_dose_blueprint_feasibility_counte.interpretation_note: Under the Blueprint upper inventory of 93,350 clonogenic opportunities per reference dose (80,000 endocrine + 13,350 vascular at f_prolif <= 1e-4), observing k == 0 in one assembled dose gives U95 = 3.20909e-5 at eta=1.0 (32.09x above 1e-6) and 6.41818e-5 at eta=0.50 (64.18x above 1e-6), so single-dose quantitative R3P-05 clearance holds at HOLD_INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_DENOMINATOR; pooling across lots or assemblies remains prohibited under GY-018, and whole-product empirical retrieval/hemostasis clearance stays separate.

r3p05_dec103_thinning_boundary_audit.joint_coverage_note: Combining a 95% LCB recovery factor with a 95% Clopper-Pearson count inversion yields >= 90% Bonferroni joint coverage ONLY when f_clonogenic_provenance == 'KNOWN_OR_CONSERVATIVELY_ESTABLISHED'; when f_clonogenic is independently estimated ('INDEPENDENTLY_ESTIMATED_WITH_ALPHA_ALLOCATION'), explicit alpha_obs + alpha_eta_recovery + alpha_f_clonogenic <= 0.10 is enforced conservatively.

fvm_model_assumptions_and_convergence_no: Periodic unit-cell 3D FVM solved on 28x28x32 meshes (grid refinement to 56x56x64-80x80x96 shifts marginal 120 um face/core values by tenths of mmHg without altering any combined face/core gate class). Post-anastomosis 2.5x GSIS OCR multiplier scales both islet and stromal gel sinks conservatively; direct intra-islet perfusion is a modeled scenario pending loaded-envelope measurement.

planar_30mmhg_buffer_solubility_sensitiv.caveat: Switching Bunsen solubility from nominal 1.34e-9 to physiological-buffer 1.27e-9 mol/(cm^3*mmHg) drops Hybrid-333 H180 clean 65 um at a 30 mmHg bed from 15.2152 to 14.4198 mmHg (< 15.0 mmHg face floor) and drops Day-0 avascular 120 um Hybrid-333 H180 at a 35 mmHg bed from 15.3775/5.9609 to 14.3801/4.5487 mmHg (failing both face and core floors); additionally 10 um of 0.5x D fibrin at 35 mmHg drops 65 um Hybrid-333 H180 face to 14.72 mmHg (< 15.0 mmHg) despite being inside the 30 um thickness cap.

model_assumptions.caveat: Continuum 1D bilateral slab Fourier model using a 1.75-min intrinsic shutoff modeling assumption (motivated by Nair 2019 S3d step-down context, NOT a directly reported Nair fitted half-time). Converged 5,000-mode reference shifts uniform slabs by +0.008-0.009 min vs 45 modes (uniform H200 3.0-min intrinsic cutoff: 1.809045 min at 5,000 modes [1.808982 min at 30,000 modes] vs 1.817482 min at 45 modes) and spatial projections by <= 0.000014 min (spatial 65 um H200 cutoff: 1.753640 min, nominal margin 0.235 s; centered 120 um VPIOs fail clean at 3.070 / 3.385 min even where Hybrid H180 nominal oxygen passes). Borderline H200 remains an unqualified scenario pending empirical chamber-corrected loaded-envelope perifusion (R3P-04).

sequential_bxb1_colony_screening_audit.transferred_planning_rates_note: Forward planning calculation of P(>=1 acceptable colony at each sequential step) from explicitly declared independent-draw planning rates (not back-solved from colony counts); Pandey 2024/2025 (PMID:38858586) provides no exact-product yield for Design Y, and direct hiPSC integration rates remain unmeasured pending Stage-0 Y-05.
sequential_bxb1_colony_screening_audit.allocation_uniqueness_note: 283 + 172 = 455 is the equal-margin (sqrt(0.95) per-stage) allocation, NOT the minimum total: exact integer minimization gives 451 colonies across 11 qualifying splits (261+190 through 271+180).
